The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Many small, dark brown/black spots scattered across the surface
- Yellow chlorotic halos surrounding the spots
- Some areas of yellowing between spots
- Browning along leaf margins

This pattern of small dark spots with yellow halos strongly suggests Bacterial Speck of Tomato. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image confirms Bacterial Speck of Tomato: small, dark brown/black spots on tomato leaves with yellow chlorotic halos — exactly matching the test image. Both images show the characteristic scattered small dark specks on green tomato leaves with associated yellowing.
